<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/openapi/reward/getLoyaltyTierDescription"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a human-readable description of the loyalty programme's earn structure and
tier rules, intended for display in customer-facing apps and portals. Unlike
`getLoyaltyTierBenefits` which returns structured data, this endpoint returns
descriptive content explaining how customers earn points and progress through tiers.
Use it to power an "About the Programme" or "How It Works" screen. Note that this
endpoint returns its response body directly — it does not use the standard
`{ status, data }` ApiResponse envelope.
